title: photonics by memory companies like SK Hynix, Micron, ..
gist: A short SemiWiki forum thread flags early photonics moves by memory makers SK Hynix and Micron in August 2026, with a reply from Daniel Nenni pointing out TSMC is pursuing the same optical-interconnect theme via its COUPE packaging platform.

insights.claim: SK Hynix issued a press release in August 2026 signaling activity in photonics technology.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: An early positioning signal that a major HBM supplier is investing in optical interconnect — worth monitoring for follow-on product announcements tied to memory bandwidth scaling.
insights.locator: SK Hynix, a press release in 2026-Aug

insights.claim: Micron was reported hiring a photonics engineer in August 2026, indicating internal photonics R&D investment.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: A second memory maker signaling optical-interconnect ambitions — a potential competitive response among HBM suppliers to the AI-driven bandwidth bottleneck.
insights.locator: Micron, hiring a photonics engineer in 2026-Aug

insights.claim: Daniel Nenni notes that TSMC is also active in photonics, referencing its silicon-photonics foundry platform and COUPE packaging architecture for AI and high-performance-computing interconnects.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: Photonics investment is not confined to pure-play optics firms — a leading-edge foundry (TSMC) is pursuing the same interconnect theme, raising the competitive stakes for memory vendors entering the space.

insights.claim: Taken together, the SK Hynix release, the Micron hire, and TSMC's parallel photonics effort suggest optical-interconnect investment is broadening beyond dedicated photonics/foundry players into memory vendors themselves.
insights.speaker: Daniel Nenni
insights.so_what: A theme worth tracking: possible early indicators of optically-interfaced memory products as a future differentiator in the HBM supply race.
insights.locator: photonics by memory companies like SK Hynix, Micron
